releases.name: Gallipoli
releases.summary:
What began on mainland Europe, was never likely to end there... Prepare for relentless WW1 beach landings and desert warfare across the Middle Eastern Front in Gallipoli!

Faced with the deadlocked trenches of the Western Front, the Triple Entente looked for new pathways to victory. What was thought to be a quick expeditionary campaign to remove a German ally from the war, ended up in a disastrous four-year campaign: the Ottoman Empire wasn’t going down without a fight.

Gallipoli marks the fourth entry in the WW1 Game Series, further broadening its authentic and realistic FPS combat experience to give you the deepest dive into the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1 yet.

releases.name: Mexican Ninja
releases.summary: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

releases.name: The Witch's Bakery
releases.summary:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

releases.name: Birds Watching
releases.summary:
An endless global fire destroyed the world, and you are now alone, the last human being.

You survive on the top of a mountain, the only place still untouched by the flames, and your only occupation is watching with your binoculars the wild birds escaped up there with you.

It is a peaceful, isolated, desperate life.

Until you are not alone anymore, and the only ones who can save you are the birds; but they are picky. Satisfy them, or lose everything. Be honest. Be ruthless. Be careful.

Birds are watching.

releases.name: Grim Trials
releases.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

releases.name: Rhapsody II: Ballad of the Little Princess
releases.summary: Join Kururu on her journey to find true love and experience the charm of Rhapsody II's storybook adventure!

releases.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Cost of Hope
releases.summary:
The fragile peace between Duty and Freedom stands on the brink of collapse. The heartlands of the Zone, forbidden for decades, now call to stalkers. New dangers - or perhaps wonders - begin to emerge.

Prepare to embark on a new expedition into the Zone in this massive nonlinear expansion, where dozens of hours of gameplay, unforgettable stories, and twisted characters await. A new chapter of the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. saga begins - shaped by your choices and actions in a journey you must survive, endure, and explore.

A chance to learn the Сost of Hope is upon us, stalkers.

releases.name: Ground Zero Hero
releases.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

releases.name: Berry Bury Berry
releases.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

releases.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
releases.summary: The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

releases.name: Mortal Shell II
releases.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

releases.name: Cyber Cycles
releases.summary:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

releases.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
releases.summary: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

releases.name: Nioh 3: Hell Rising
releases.summary: A new shadow of intrigue takes over future Edo in Hell Rising. Our protagonist and appointed shogun, Takechiyo, journeys through time and is led to Edo in the future by an unknown yokai he met in his dreams. There, following the death of the future Takechiyo, the era of peace has ended, and Edo has been retaken by the Crucible. With the cooperation of a one-eyed swordsman, Yagyu Jubei, and a Spanish envoy, Rodrigo, Takechiyo faces yet another plot revolving around Spirit Stones and an enemy with a strong resentment towards the shogunate.

releases.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
releases.summary:
February 5, 2012. A little girl named Seowon is reported missing from a playground. Police launch an investigation and question witnesses and suspects, but Seowon's case is never solved.

Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case.

But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

#No_Case_Should_Remain_Unsolved is a detective game where players uncover and piece together memory fragments to solve a long-forgotten case. Follow former police detective Jeon Gyeong as she acquires clues and testimony relating to the case of a missing girl.

releases.name: No More Slimes!!
releases.summary:
The once peaceful Miallut Canyon has been overrun by a mysterious army of slimes. What started as a mere nuisance has now escalated into a massive commotion threatening the entire canyon.

You are the only fixer who can quell this chaos. Break through your limits as you hunt the endlessly swarming slimes, and join forces with unique mercenaries who have crossed dimensions.

Will you be able to find the true culprit behind the Slime Pandemonium and restore peace to the canyon?

releases.name: Backyard Baseball
releases.summary: The timeless classic is leveling up with all-new game modes, new ways to play, brand-new features and more. It’s the game you love, reimagined for a whole new era. Get ready for Backyard Baseball like you've never experienced it before.

releases.name: The Sinking City 2
releases.summary:
The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension. 

* Immerse yourself in a distinct atmosphere of cosmic horror and twisted designs drawn from the dark wellsprings of HP Lovecraft's macabre imagination. 
* Explore and survive the city of Arkham, a sprawling labyrinth of flooded alleys and decrepit mansions where eldritch horrors lurk just out of sight. 
* Use an arsenal of weapons to fight off Deep Ones, Mi-gos, occult zealots, and other iconic monsters from the source material as well as new and unique creatures that expand the Cthulhu Mythos. 
* Experience the classic survival horror formula at its finest, complete with inventory management, optional puzzles, and backtracking to newly unlocked areas and hidden treasures. 
* Use environmental storytelling and scattered clues to solve side mysteries that unlock new outcomes and gameplay bonuses.  
* Thanks to Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City 2 delivers next-gen visuals with Lumen global illumination, photorealistic Nanite geometry, life-like Metahuman-powered characters, and much more.

releases.name: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
releases.summary: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams is the latest installment in Capcom's third-person action franchise. You play as Soki, a young and powerful warrior who, with the help of some friends, attempts to defeat the evil Hideyoshi and the Genma forces. There are new characters, artificial intelligence-controlled secondary characters, and a new gameplay system that lets you take control of various characters throughout the game. In addition, you will be able to customize your character, weapons, and attacks.

releases.name: Politics The Game
releases.summary: Become a parliamentarian, create a powerful party, and lead it to victory in this humorous RPG. Manage your popularity and dignity, use unique powers, and navigate a storyline inspired by current events.

releases.name: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
releases.summary: A civilization shadowed with mystery, guarded by mythical monsters, controlled by a mighty crystal that- in the wrong hands- could destroy the legendary empire. Now, with the aid of a submarine and a mysterious book, go on a journey in search of Atlantis: The Lost Empire. Along the way you will encounter huge sea-creatures, fiery volcanoes, mutiny, and even a beautiful princess. Are you ready to take on this mission?

releases.name: Starsand Island
releases.summary:
This Killer Deck has won tournaments and has crushed hundreds of opponents. You have to check this Killer Deck out for yourself, and see if you can build a deck just like it. Then, check and test it with the people you duel with, Improve your Skills, Learn the Game and become a Master Duelist!


-A Killer Deck contains, strong four-star monsters
-A way to summon tribute monsters without having to tribute
-A way to draw extra cards
-40 cards in your deck ,and no more
-Cards the let you search your deck for other cards
-Creatures that summon other creatures when their destroyed
-Cards that can wipe out your opponent's monsters, traps, spells and fusion cards.

With the correct combination of monster, traps, spells and fusion cards you can make your own Killer Deck unbeatable.

releases.name: The Long Survival
releases.summary:
A Long Survive is a cooperative shooter game focused on survival against waves of varied enemies. It is an intense action game with resource management, real-time strategy and building elements. 

In A Long Survive, you will take on the role of a soldier from Space Corp. You will have to go with your team to one of the extraction bases on the new planets taken by humans. But obviously, it won't be easy. These extraction bases are besieged by the Lerp army. You will have to survive their waves as long as you can while protecting the nexus.

Will you be able to complete the mission? Or will you have to escape?

releases.name: Black Flower
releases.summary: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the Black Flower bloom.
